_doc: Plausible-range guardrails for the observation quality gate (tools/_shared/observation-quality.js). NOT price claims and never rendered to users — engineering bounds in cents for the expected wholesale unit, used to catch units flips and sentinels (a value < min/2 or > max*2 is hard-rejected; mildly out of band is down-weighted). Wide on purpose; tighten as real data arrives. Keyed by ingredientKey.
